arguments.description: Get single batch details by uniqueName: stock/variant, mfg/expiry, days remaining,. Part of the All APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

q.description: Search text (case sensitivity depends on the endpoint).

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Default: createdAt.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: desc.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour.

stockUniqueNames.description: Array of stock unique names values.

variantUniqueNames.description: Array of variant unique names values.

warehouseUniqueNames.description: Array of warehouse unique names values.

batchUniqueNames.description: Array of batch unique names values.

available.description: When true, applies the available filter or flag.

expiredOnly.description: When true, applies the expired only filter or flag.

archive.description: When true, applies the archive filter or flag.

includeArchived.description: When true, applies the include archived filter or flag.

inventoryType.description: Inventory type. Allowed values: PRODUCT, SERVICE, FIXED_ASSETS.
